written.headline: China proposes export controls on 23 AI technologies
written.summary: China's draft rules released on Oct. 16 would add 23 AI‑related technologies, including large language models, agents, chip designs and computing clusters, to its export‑control list. The measures would allow overseas users to access Chinese AI services via websites and cloud platforms while requiring government approval for transfers of underlying models, data or expertise.
